scope: Desktop only; identifiers, layout geometry, encoding, image loading and navigation. No topic or pixel review.

original.intrinsicWidth: Preserve the source desktop layout; original source itself extends to1310px at the1280px browser viewport. Horizontal scrolling is retained inside the original viewer.

sandbox.scope: Ten entries exercised by catalogue mouse navigation in the sandbox viewer; all71 source pages rendered independently. The control interface lost its child target before entry10, so remaining navigation is not claimed as71 sandbox mouse tests.

navigationFix.before: A catalogue entry loaded the full Wix page inside the catalogue HTML component.
navigationFix.after: Owned embedded frame sends the selected captured URL to its source page; the source page performs the navigation.

home.extraLinks: Three source typography aliases link to the same works.

limitations: No game packages downloaded or executed.
Source native desktop width is preserved rather than redesigned.
Only the actual embedded forum URLs are archived; this is not a crawl of all forum pagination.
